'''Hogsbreth'''<ref name="Getty">{{Getty|url=thewaltdisneystudios/allaccess/#!asset/hc968sf4xx57p8snxm8pb93s|text=THND-013615 R|author=[[The Walt Disney Company|The Walt Disney Studios]]|date=2026-03-24|archivedate=20260324133838}}</ref> was an [[Iktotchi]] who resided in [[the galaxy]] during the [[New Republic Era]]. At some point, they sat in the stands of an arena beside the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Neo-Imperial forces|Remnant]] [[Lord]] [[Janu]], who himself sat next to the [[youngling]] [[Din Grogu]], who was imprisoned inside a cage. The Iktotchi's right head horn was damaged.<ref name="Empire" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Hogsbreth was revealed in an image within the [[May]] [[2026]] issue of [[Wikipedia:Empire (magazine)|''Empire'']] magazine,<ref name="Empire" /> and identified by the caption of the image when it was posted on [[Wikipedia:Getty Images|Getty Images]] on [[March 24]], 2026. The character is portrayed by [[Matthew Willig]].<ref name="Getty" />
